grh_0b40c62d36f17b33e223.title: Glamour
paragraphs: Thirteen years earlier, young widow Ellen McCarty asked Dr. Christian to find a home for her three-year-old daughter Glamour because Ellen intended to marry wealthy Carter Gaylord, who did not know the child existed. John and Evie Clark raised Glamour with Ellen's financial support. After Gaylord's death, Ellen returns to Rivers End and seeks custody of the now sixteen-year-old girl, promising wealth, travel and every social advantage. A judge leaves the final choice to Glamour. When Christian refuses to influence her, Ellen tries to force the decision by offering lifelong security to the Clarks if Glamour comes with her and threatening to withdraw every cent if she refuses. Glamour angrily chooses John and Evie and rejects the mother who abandoned her. The confrontation brings on another heart attack for Evie, and Ellen finally begins to understand that money and pressure cannot manufacture affection. Christian tells her that if she truly wants her daughter back in her life she must earn that relationship through patience and consideration. He suggests that Ellen build a summer cottage nearby, giving mother and daughter a chance to know each other gradually without uprooting Glamour from the family that raised her.
GRH catalogs [[show|dr-christian|Dr. Christian]]'s "Glamour" for April 17, 1940, as episode 76.
